Name: Advanced Flute Blocks
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
[i]Update to 1.6 thanks to mouahrara[/i]

[youtube]JBCo0Kb-w_A[/youtube]

[b][size=4]Changing Flute Block Pitch[/size][/b]

This mod lets you quickly change a flute block pitch by hovering over a placed flute block and scrolling with the mouse while holding down the [b]Left Shift[/b] key.


[b][size=4]Changing Flute Block Tone[/size][/b]

This mod lets you change the tone made by a placed flute block by hovering over it and scrolling with the mouse while holding down the [b]Left Alt[/b] key.

There are four tones available to switch between:

[list]
[*]flute
[*]toyPiano
[*]crystal
[*]clam_tone
[/list]
If I can figure out why the tone of other sounds doesn't change I can try to add more.



[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
